name: floating-panel
blurb: Floating panel that expands from a trigger button with spring animation.
description: A FloatingPanelRoot with trigger button that animates into a floating panel; includes form components and footer buttons.
use_when: Creating inline forms or quick-edit panels that expand from a trigger button without interrupting workflow.
avoid_when: For complex multi-step forms — this is optimized for quick, lightweight interactions.
a11y: Trigger button has aria-haspopup=dialog and aria-expanded; form elements are labeled; Escape closes panel.
